description: Frontend: FC26 Database source card + import report panel, Player Retention toggle/config in Create Auction Setup, retention screen inside the lobby page (team switcher, search, position chips, player cards, retained panel, confirm + finalize dialogs), UNDERDOG tag across all player-name surfaces, pot labels, base price display, START gating. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 wire contract. See plan.md D6, D7, D10, D11.
steps: FIRST read frontend/AGENTS.md and the relevant guides in frontend/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ (app router, client components) before writing Next.js code. Follow the ui-ux-pro-max rules from the task rules (lucide-react icons not emoji, cursor-pointer, visible focus, stable hover, contrast, reduced motion) and reuse components/ui/* and the existing dark lobby/auction styling.

Types and wire contract: extend frontend/src/types/index.ts (RoomSettings: playerPoolSource adds 'fc26', retentionEnabled; Player: playerTag, draftPool, sourceCategory, positions, potential, fullName, isRetained; Team: retainedCount, retentionSpent, auctionPurse) and frontend/src/types/backend.ts (SettingsDTO playerPoolSource + retention.enabled, PlayerDTO fields, TeamDTO fields, RoomStateDTO.retention, ClientCommand RETAIN_PLAYER/FINALIZE_RETENTIONS/RESET_RETENTIONS, event payloads PLAYER_RETAINED/RETENTION_FINALIZED/RETENTION_RESET, add the three names to parseServerEvent `names`). Update services/contract.ts (mapPlayer, mapTeams, mapSettings, settingsToDTO sending playerPoolSource 'FC26'|'DEFAULT' and retention {enabled}); remove the default-only guard in services/room.service.ts createRoom (csv/custom stay unavailable).

Create services/fc26.service.ts (status, import report) and services/retention.service.ts (GET /rooms/:code/retention/players with AbortController support via api.get options, and WS commands through webSocketService.send). Add lib/pots.ts label map (GK Goalkeepers, CB Centre-backs, FB Fullbacks, MID Midfielders, ATT Attackers, others unchanged) and use it where `player.pot` is shown (PlayerAuctionCard, PlayerPoolSidebar).

Create components/shared/UnderdogTag.tsx (small distinct badge, accessible label) and render it beside the name when player.playerTag==='UNDERDOG' in: PlayerAuctionCard, PlayerPoolSidebar, SoldOverlay, UnsoldOverlay, CurrentBid, TeamPanel, TeamQuickView, TeamViewDrawer (squad list and player details), RecallPlayersModal, results/{AuctionHighlights,TeamResultCard,TransferTable}, team/SquadFormationView, room/PlayerCatalogPreview, retention cards. Regular players render unchanged. Mark retained players with a small RETAINED label in squad/history lists and keep them out of the pool sidebar's upcoming/waiting views.

app/create/page.tsx: add a fourth source card 'FC26 Database' (grid becomes sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4; default/csv/custom behave as today), selecting it sets playerPoolSource 'fc26' and minPlayerBasePrice 1 (field disabled with note); add components/fc26/Fc26ImportPanel.tsx showing catalog counts and an 'Import FC26 database' action that renders the report (imported, skipped duplicates, invalid rows, missing files) with loading/error states; add a 'Player Retention' card with an ON/OFF toggle (reuse the anti-sniping switch markup) that, when ON, shows retention price 15 Cr (fixed, read-only), max 3 per team, min 0, 'must be completed before the auction starts' and the exact text: "Each team can retain up to 3 players from the available FC26 database before the auction. Every retained player costs 15 Cr and will be added directly to the team's squad." Turning retention ON selects FC26 (and blocks choosing another source while ON, with a notice); block submit when FC26 is chosen and the catalog is empty. Preserve all existing validation and submit behavior.

Create components/retention/*: RetentionScreen (heading 'Player Retention'; reads useAuctionStore snapshot.retention and teams; loading/empty/error states), RetentionTeamSwitcher (all teams, current team name + manager, remaining purse, retained count 0/3, remaining slots; read-only view of other teams), RetentionFilters (search input with search icon, debounced ~200 ms, chips All, GK, CB, LB/RB/LWB/RWB, CDM/CM/CAM, LM/RM, ST/CF, LW/RW/LF/RF mapped to backend group ids, combined with search), RetentionPlayerCard (photo via PlayerImage, full name, overall, primary position, nationality, club, base price, UNDERDOG tag, retention price 15 Cr, Retain button disabled with reason when full/insufficient purse/not your team/finalized), RetainedPlayersPanel, FinalizeRetentionsDialog (host only; summary of teams, retained players, spend, remaining purse, total retained; uses ConfirmDialog/Modal), plus a host 'Reset retentions' confirm. Retain click opens a confirmation dialog, then sends RETAIN_PLAYER; counts, purse and card availability update from ROOM_STATE immediately; refetch the list when retention picks change. Per-team summary shows 0 correctly.

app/room/[roomCode]/page.tsx and components/room/HostControls.tsx: when snapshot.settings.retention.enabled render RetentionScreen; START LIVE AUCTION stays disabled with a visible reason until retention.phase==='FINALIZED' (retention OFF unchanged); show an informational line for non-hosts. Show retention status in components/room/AuctionSettingsSummary.tsx.

Add frontend/tests/retention-ui.mjs in the style of tests/recall-ui.mjs (offline component test: renders RetentionScreen with a stubbed snapshot and stubbed service; checks search + chip filtering combine, Retain confirm flow sends RETAIN_PLAYER, 4th retain disabled, UNDERDOG tag shown only for underdog, finalize dialog only for host).
acceptance_criteria: `cd frontend; npm run typecheck` passes (no backend imports)
`cd frontend; node tests/retention-ui.mjs` passes (or the report states chromium could not launch)
Create Auction Setup shows the FC26 Database option and the Player Retention toggle with the fixed price info and exact explanation text; existing sources and OFF behavior are unchanged
UNDERDOG tag appears only for players with playerTag UNDERDOG in all listed surfaces
The retention screen supports team navigation, search, combined position filters, Retain with confirmation, finalize with summary, and START is disabled until finalized
findings:
Verification: `npm run typecheck` PASS; `npx next build` PASS (Next 16.3.5, 11 static pages, no TS errors); `node tests/retention-ui.mjs` PASS (headless chrome launched; one scenario: team summary, UNDERDOG tag only for underdog, search+chip combine, retain confirm sends RETAIN_PLAYER only after confirm, 4th retain disabled, other team read-only, host-only finalize dialog with summary). No backend files touched.
New files: frontend/src/components/retention/{RetentionScreen,RetentionFilters,RetentionPlayerCard,RetentionTeamSwitcher,RetainedPlayersPanel,FinalizeRetentionsDialog}.tsx; components/fc26/Fc26ImportPanel.tsx; components/shared/UnderdogTag.tsx (exports UnderdogTag, RetainedTag); services/fc26.service.ts (fc26Service.status/importAll); services/retention.service.ts (retentionService.players/retain/finalize/reset); lib/pots.ts (potLabel); tests/retention-ui.mjs.
Wire: types/backend.ts adds RetentionStateDTO/RetentionPickDTO/RetentionTeamDTO/RetentionPlayerDTO/RetentionGroup/Fc26*DTO, RETAIN_PLAYER/FINALIZE_RETENTIONS/RESET_RETENTIONS commands, PLAYER_RETAINED/RETENTION_FINALIZED/RETENTION_RESET events (added to parseServerEvent names). contract.ts maps playerTag/draftPool/sourceCategory/positions/potential/fullName/isRetained, team retainedCount/retentionSpent/auctionPurse, settings playerPoolSource 'fc26'|'default' + retentionEnabled; settingsToDTO always sends playerPoolSource DEFAULT|FC26 and retention {enabled} on create. room.service.createRoom now allows 'default' and 'fc26' (csv/custom still blocked).
Behavior: RetentionScreen is prop-driven ({roomCode, snapshot: RoomStateDTO, isHost}); the lobby page passes useAuctionStore snapshot. Player list refetches (AbortController) when the picks set, search (200 ms debounce) or chip changes; 'Show more players' appends by offset (page size 50). START in HostControls is disabled with a visible reason (startBlockedReason) until snapshot.retention.phase==='FINALIZED'. Create page: FC26 card is the 4th card (grid lg:grid-cols-4), selecting it or turning retention ON sets minPlayerBasePrice 1 (input disabled) and restores the previous floor when leaving FC26; while retention is ON other sources are blocked with a notice; submit blocked when FC26 selected and catalog total===0 (unknown total is allowed, backend returns FC26_CATALOG_EMPTY).
Deviations: (1) UNDERDOG tag not added to CurrentBid, TeamPanel, TeamResultCard because those render team names/aggregates only, no player names. (2) Retained players stay in the pool sidebar list (status SOLD) with a RETAINED label but are excluded from the 'x / y SOLD' progress counts; they are never in waiting/live views because the backend marks them SOLD. (3) RETAINED label also shown in TeamQuickView, TeamViewDrawer, SquadFormationView, TransferTable. (4) Pot labels applied in PlayerAuctionCard, PlayerPoolSidebar and PlayerCatalogPreview; PlayerCatalogPreview takes optional source='FC26' prop. (5) Retain button is disabled for other teams with reason text; no backend call for another team's retention. (6) Existing mojibake in some pre-existing strings (â¢ etc.) left untouched. Real FC26 CSVs and .agents/ remain untracked/uncommitted; backend/test-results/ is an untracked pre-existing artifact.
